outcome: Morize has a minimal cross-platform Rust workspace with stable typed identities, bounded domain types, deterministic serialization/validation, versioned configuration, error contracts, and real verification commands that downstream vault and policy work can depend on.
rationale: P1 is a cross-cutting dependency and must not be hidden inside the vault/persistence specification. This node owns the deterministic base contracts shared by storage, policy, retrieval, APIs, and later adapters. Foundation planning closeout is a repository-governance prerequisite satisfied by canonical merge plus required review and evidence closure, not a SpecGrain execution-dependency edge.
title: Build deterministic Rust kernel and canonical data contracts
